summary: VYNE Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing a special cash dividend declared in connection with its proposed merger with Yarrow Bioscience. The dividend is estimated at $16.5 million aggregate or $0.38 per share, payable to stockholders and warrant holders of record as of July 22, 2026, with payment conditioned upon closing of the merger. The merger, structured as a reverse subsidiary merger, will result in Yarrow becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of VYNE. The special dividend effectively distributes excess net cash to shareholders as part of the deal terms. The press release was furnished under Item 7.01. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearance affecting the closure timeline.
